title: 4v4 switch the play
summary: Two teams play 4v4 with a bonus goal for a pass across the pitch to a wide target player.

steps.instruction: Play 4v4 to two small goals. Place a target player on each touchline.
A pass from one side to the far target player scores a bonus point.
Swap target players and teams. Play one more round.

coachingPoints: Change the point of attack quickly

progressions.change: Allow two touches only for the defending team.
Limit each team to three touches.
